name: Ashikita (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Ashikita town emblem in white: a stylised bird-like device with a ring and a pointed base.
history: Municipal flag of Ashikita, a town in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 2005.

features.role: Ashikita town emblem — a stylised bird-like device with a ring and a pointed base
